# Judith Chapter 9 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Judith 9 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/JDT_009_page_001.jpg

---

**9:1** And Judith fell upon her-face and put ashes on her-head and uncovered the-sackcloth with which she-was-clothed. And the-incense of that-evening was-being-offered in Jerusalem in-the house of-God at-that-very-time. And Judith cried-out to-the Lord with a-loud voice and said:

**9:2** "O Lord God of my-father Simeon, into whose-hand you-gave a-sword for-vengeance against the-strangers who-loosed the-girdle of a-virgin to-defile her, and uncovered the-thigh to her-shame, and defiled the-womb to her-reproach — for you-said, 'It-shall-not be-so' — and yet they-did-[it].

**9:3** Therefore you-gave their-rulers for-slaughter, and their-bed, which was-ashamed at their-deceit, [you gave] to-blood, and you-struck-down slaves-together-with-lords and lords upon their-thrones.

**9:4** And their-wives you-gave for-plunder and their-daughters for-captivity, and all their-spoils for-distribution among the-sons beloved-of-you, who were-zealous with your-zeal and abhorred the-pollution of their-blood and called-upon you for-help. O God, my God, hear me also — a-widow.

**9:5** For you-did all things past, and those-after-them, and those-now, and those-being-planned. And the-things that-are-present and the-things-to-come you-have-planned, and they-have-come-about — yes, the-things you-intended-in-your-mind have-presented-themselves and said, 'Behold, we-are-here.'

**9:6** For all your-ways are-prepared and your-judgment is with foreknowledge.

**9:7** Behold — the-Assyrians have-multiplied in their-power; they-are-exalted in horse and rider; they-are-gloried in the-strength of foot-soldiers; they-have-trusted in shield and spear and bow and sling, and they-do-not-know that you are-the-Lord who-crushes wars.

**9:8** The-Lord is your-name. Crush their-might in your-power and shatter their-force in your-wrath. For they-have-planned to-profane your-sanctuaries, to-defile the-tabernacle of-the resting-place of-the name of your-glory, to-strike-down with iron the-horn of your-altar.

**9:9** Look upon their-arrogance and send your-wrath upon their-heads. Give into my-hand — the-hand of a-widow — what I-have-planned.

**9:10** Beat-down with my-lips and my-deceit the-slave-together-with the-ruler and the-ruler together-with his-servant; crush their-arrogance by-the-hand of a-woman.

**9:11** For your-might does not lie in-multitude, nor your-dominion in-strong-men. Rather you are a-God of-the humble, a-helper of-the-insignificant, a-supporter of-the-weak, a-guardian of-the despairing, a-savior of-the-hopeless.

**9:12** Yes, yes, God of my-father and God of-the inheritance of Israel, Master-of-the-heavens and earth, Creator of-the waters, King of all your-creation — hear my-prayer,

**9:13** and make my-word and my-deceit a wound and a-bruise to those who have-purposed hard-things against your-covenant and your-consecrated house and Mount Zion and the-house your-children possess.

**9:14** And make every nation and tribe of-yours to-know and to-understand that you are God — God of all-power and-might — and that there-is no-other who-guards the-race of Israel except you."
